title: Unique Badge Identifier
description: At an international tech conference, every attendee wears a smart badge with a unique hexadecimal ID code. However, due to a system glitch, one attendee's badge ID was not duplicated, while every other badge ID was issued to exactly two different attendees. Given an array of attendee badge identifiers, find the single attendee who has the unique badge ID.
constraints: Each element in the array appears twice except for one element which appears only once.
input_format: An array of integers representing the badge identifiers.
output_format: An integer representing the unique badge ID.

examples.explanation: The number 1 appears only once, while 2 appears twice.
The numbers 1 and 2 appear twice, while 4 appears once.
Only one badge is present, which is the unique one.
